title: World leaders watch anxiously as cracks emerge in fragile U.S., Iran ceasefire
text: World leaders watch anxiously as cracks emerge in fragile U.S., Iran ceasefireThe U.S. and Iran agreed to a ceasefire less than one day ago. Already, that fragile agreement appears to be fraying – threatening global trade and stability, yet again. Gillian Tett, Richard Stengel, David Rohde, and Tim O'Brien discuss on The 11th Hour.
